instructions.description: Lie on your back on the floor or exercise mat and bend your legs so your feet are planted with the soles of your feet on the floor or mat.
Exhale and bring yourself up so that your shoulder blades are hovering just above the floor or mat.
Stay lifted and extend your arms by your sides, slowly moving from side to side to tap the outside part of your ankles with the corresponding hand while keeping your chin lifted off your chest.
Keep your shoulder blades off the mat for the whole exercise.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count repetitions completed with controlled technique.
